nodes.description: Public token name string state variable set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string state variable set in the constructor.
Token decimals (18) stored as a public uint8 state variable.
Total token supply; set in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Constructor; mints the entire supply to the deployer (msg.sender) and sets metadata.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unguarded subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Subtracts tokens from balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and adds to balances[to] via safeAdd.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowance; no allowance sufficiency check is performed.
Checked addition helper: c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction helper: require(b <= a); c = a - b.
Checked multiplication helper with overflow require.
Checked division helper requiring b > 0.
Caller-controlled address; used as minter, allowance owner, allowance spender and balance holder.
Subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() performed without SafeMath.
Unrestricted write to allowed[msg.sender][spender] with an arbitrary caller-supplied amount.
State mutation of balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] driven by a caller-supplied token amount.
State mutation of balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] executed without verifying the allowance is sufficient.
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf().
Owner address passed to allowance().
Spender address passed to allowance().
Spender address that becomes a key in the allowed mapping.
Caller-supplied allowance amount stored by approve().
Recipient address of transfer().
Caller-supplied amount transferred by transfer().
Source address debited by transferFrom().
Recipient address credited by transferFrom().
Caller-supplied amount moved by transferFrom().
First operand of safeAdd().
Second operand of safeAdd().

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor as the recipient of the entire initial supply.
_totalSupply is credited to balances[msg.sender] during construction.
balances mapping is keyed and mutated using the caller-supplied msg.sender.
allowed mapping is keyed by msg.sender as owner and spender.
approve() stores the allowance under the caller-controlled msg.sender key.
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender] with no additional authorisation.
transferFrom() decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using msg.sender as spender.
Constructor assigns the token name state variable.
Constructor assigns the token symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the fixed _totalSupply value.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply as the left operand of the subtraction.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] as the right operand of the subtraction.
balanceOf() reads from the balances mapping.
allowance() reads from the nested allowed mapping.
approve() writes the arbitrary amount into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer() mutates balances for sender and recipient using SafeMath helpers.
transferFrom() mutates balances[from] and balances[to] using SafeMath helpers.
transferFrom() decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking sufficiency.
transfer() invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer() invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom() invokes safeSub twice for balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom() invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
totalSupply() contains an unguarded subtraction that is not routed through SafeMath.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unguarded subtraction operation.
approve() performs an unrestricted allowance write controlled by the caller.
transfer() mutates balances with a caller-supplied token amount.
transferFrom() mutates balances and allowance without verifying allowance >= tokens.
The tokens parameter flows directly into the allowed mapping write in approve().
The tokens parameter supplies the allowance value stored by approve().
The tokens parameter flows into the balance updates of transfer().
The tokens parameter flows into the unchecked balance and allowance updates of transferFrom().
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf().
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
spender parameter becomes the second key of allowed[msg.sender][spender].
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer().
tokens parameter is the amount subtracted and added in transfer().
from parameter is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom().
to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom().
Parameter a is the first operand of the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b is the second operand of the safeAdd addition.
Local c stores and returns the safeAdd result.
Parameter a is the minuend of the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter b is the subtrahend and the require(b <= a) bound of safeSub.
Local c stores and returns the safeSub result.
